📌 Recently Asked – Impetus Interview for Big Data Engineer
📍 Round 1 – Technical (Hands-on + Conceptual)

Just came across these questions asked in the R1 round at Impetus for a Big Data Engineer (3–5 yrs) role:

🔷 Project-Based & Real-Time Scenarios
1️⃣ Walkthrough of your current project and workflow
 2️⃣ What was the data source in your project?
 3️⃣ Any production or lower-environment issue you faced and how you resolved it

🔷 Apache Spark & PySpark
4️⃣ Spark application internal process
 5️⃣ What is Data Locality?
 6️⃣ What is DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) in Spark?
 7️⃣ Number of stages in PySpark
 8️⃣ Partitioning logic for 1GB/2GB of data
 9️⃣ Default partitions after wide transformations
 🔟 Handling empty partitions after shuffle
 1️⃣1️⃣ What is Data Skew? How do you handle it?
 1️⃣2️⃣ Salting technique in Spark
 1️⃣3️⃣ How does coalesce() help with skew
 1️⃣4️⃣ Broadcast joins in Spark
 1️⃣5️⃣ Adaptive Query Execution (AQE)
 1️⃣6️⃣ RDD vs DataFrame – Why is DataFrame faster?
 1️⃣7️⃣ Catalyst Optimizer in Spark
 1️⃣8️⃣ PySpark Coding Task:
 • Find product names where latest month’s sales > average of last 3 months
 1️⃣9️⃣ SQL Equivalent:
 • Write a SQL query for the same logic

🔷 Python & Problem Solving
2️⃣0️⃣ What is a Lambda Function?
 2️⃣1️⃣ Purpose of __init__ method
 2️⃣2️⃣ What is a Decorator?
 2️⃣3️⃣ What is GIL (Global Interpreter Lock)?
 2️⃣4️⃣ What is Pickling and Unpickling in Python?
 2️⃣5️⃣ What is use of .format() method?
 2️⃣6️⃣ Logic: Find the first non-repeating character in a string


✅ A great mix of real-time concepts, coding challenges, and optimization questions.
Hope this helps others preparing for Impetus or similar roles.
